name: comp-261
title: Vertical Slider
description: A single-value slider turned on its side, standing vertically under a small centred label. The track fills white beneath the knob as the value climbs.
use: A single level or height should sit in a tall narrow slot beside a tool or preview.
avoid: No number or scale is shown, so the exact value is hard to read.
a11y: It is named for assistive tech and accepts arrow keys, but no readout tells anyone the current value. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small grey label is centred at the top. Below it a narrow vertical grey track runs down the middle, with a solid white lower section and a round white knob resting partway up.
behaves: Dragging the knob up or down moves it in ten even steps, and the white fill follows beneath it. The knob carries a soft ring while it is being held.
customise: The label text and maximum value are in the source, along with the fixed height; the orientation is not switchable by a prop here.
weight: light: One vertical track and a knob; nothing moves when untouched.
